ns2:section.sectionText: This is an open forum series targeted toward students who wish to pursue future opportunities in investment management. Students will be exposed to basic business valuation tools and topics, and be able to better plan coursework for the duration of their undergraduate studies, be able to successfully interview with recruiters to become security analysts, as well as have the potential to make equity investments in a Student Managed Fund. Guest speakers who are investment professionals will be utilized to the extent possible, and may require additional attendance dates outside of the normal classroom hours.
